title: Jets not happy that Jared Verse wasn't flagged for hit on Geno Smith

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets not happy that Jared Verse wasn't flagged for hit on Geno Smith
sources.description: Browns defensive end Jared Verse was not flagged for a hit on Sunday in which he lowered the top of his helmet into the side of Jets quarterback Geno Smith's helmet.
